flags.old: Through Nib's eyes: a gate, wired into a steel frame. No tape, no cones, no warning sign.
flags.problem: The right half shows a jagged glowing slit cut into the pier wall under the yellow 7, with cables lying on the ground beside it, but there is no steel frame anywhere round its rim, so 'wired into a steel frame' describes something not drawn.
flags.new: Through Nib's eyes: a gate glowing under the painted seven, cables snaking toward it. No tape, no cones, no warning sign.

flags.old: Saturday's gate is a D-grade, a step up: a car park drowned in black water, with one long dry ramp down into it.
flags.problem: The ramp is drawn glossy-wet, with lamp reflections along its whole visible length, so 'one long dry ramp' contradicts the panel; the first half also restates the caption (echo 0.36).
flags.new: Saturday's gate is a step up from the last two: a car park drowned in black water, with one long ramp rising out of it.

flags.old: Nib climbs onto the ceiling pipe above the dry part of the ramp.
flags.problem: Nib is already crouched on the pipe, one hand on it and the other on the knives at his back, and no ramp is in frame (the ramp under the pipe is drawn wet in P32 and P35), so neither 'climbs onto' nor 'the dry part of the ramp' matches the panel.
flags.new: Nib perches on the ceiling pipe like a gargoyle, one hand already resting on his knives.

flags.old: Twelve thousand people watched live, and the chat loved the flying husk, and the car even more.
flags.problem: The phone shows the stream still running (12,480 WATCHING), but the line is in the past tense, against the present-tense rule, as if the stream had ended.
flags.new: Twelve thousand people are watching live, and the chat loves the flying husk, and the car even more.

flags.old: The core drifts into Jaeha's bandaged hand. One more thing for the notebook.
flags.problem: The hand closing on the core wears a black fingerless glove and the bandage is on the forearm above it, not on the hand; 'one more thing for the notebook' only restates his inner line 'I'll write that down too'.
flags.new: The core drifts into his gloved palm. The missing button goes in the notebook, along with the hidden gate.

flags.old: Then pork belly on the rooftop grill with everyone, and Gomi watching Nib from the water tank.
flags.problem: Gomi lies on top of the water tank with half-closed eyes, her face turned toward the camera, not toward Nib, who sits on a crate below and to the left.
flags.new: Then pork belly on the rooftop grill with everyone, and Gomi stretched out on the water tank above them.

flags.old: Route Alignment fills to a hundred percent. Now, somehow, his voice can reach the Far Side.
flags.problem: The line only restates the window on screen (60 to 100 percent, THE FAR SIDE CAN HEAR YOU NOW; echo 0.50) and says nothing about what is drawn: Jaeha staring up with his lips parted.
flags.new: Jaeha stares up, lips parted, as the bar brims. His voice can now carry all the way to Nib's world.

flags.old: Then one huge window, one button: a call, like the one that brought Nib. This time Jaeha speaks first.
flags.problem: Jaeha stands silent with one hand half raised and does not speak until chapter 9; the window only invites him to, so 'speaks first' narrates an action this panel does not show.
flags.new: Then one huge window, one button: a call, like the one that brought Nib. This time, Jaeha has to speak first.

art_vs_script.note: No steel frame is drawn round the gate's rim, and the cables run along the ground from the generator toward the gate's base instead of plugging into a frame; the slit is cut into the pier wall itself and glows violet with a blue-white rim, where the script asks for white-cyan.
Gomi is already out on the roof beside Nib, walking toward the camera, instead of strolling through the stair door right behind him.

The ramp is glossy-wet along its whole length here and in P32, P35, P37, P44, P50 and P57. The script makes only the lower third wet, and the plan depends on that ('onto dry ground', 'clumsy on dry concrete').

The plan panel draws the real characters (Nib crouched on the pipe, Jaeha standing in the water, Yerin at the top) in full colour; only the arrow and the circle are cyan. The script asks for a desaturated diagram with small cyan figures.
Gomi lies on the water tank with half-closed eyes facing the camera; the script has her eyes fixed on Nib.
